subject: Prices in the bad days, a bulletproof case in the good days
alt: Panju Ganguli's cartoon: the picture is split in two. On the left, on a pale green ground, the words 'BURE DIN' stand at the top; Amitabh Bachchan, with glasses, a white beard and a black kurta, throws both arms wide, and two lines pointing at him carry the words 'RUPEE FALLING. VERY BAD!!' and 'PETROL PRICES RISING. TOO BAD!!'. On the right, on a yellow ground, are the words 'ACHHE DIN'; the same star, in a red vest with white dots, stands smiling inside a glass case marked 'BULLET PROOF', while white bullet trails strike the glass. The cartoonist's signature at the bottom centre: PANJU GANGULI.
chutki: In the bad days Amitabh Bachchan wrings his hands over the falling rupee and the rising petrol: the rupee is falling, very bad! Petrol is rising, too bad! In the good days the same star stands smiling in a red vest inside a bulletproof glass case, and the bullets strike the glass and fall away.

Panju Ganguli's jibe is at Amitabh Bachchan. On 1 November he waved to fans outside Jalsa from behind bulletproof glass; reports said he had received a bomb threat. The cartoon says: the star who complains about prices like the common man has his 'achhe din' inside a bulletproof case.
